title: Pier Water Sports

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Fluidmotions has been putting smiles on the faces of its customers since it was established in 1997. Whether its learning a new sport, working on technique, or just riding the wild Banana Boat, Fluidmotions can make it happen. Over the many years of coaching, we at Fluidmotions have developed a fool proof method that will help you reach your goals whether your 4 years old or 80. Whether your a beginner or a weekend warrior, we can help! If you think that this is only a ride for kids, you would be seriously mistaken. Although we do tame it down for the young ones, we turn up the intensity from "mild to wild" for the teens and adults. This is like riding a Bucking Bronco on the water.

explain.meaning: A long inflatable seating several riders, towed behind a boat.

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: We are the proud owners of the famous Party Barge. The only vessel on this side of town that truly is a party on the water. Featuring bluetooth audio, plenty of seating for up to 24 passengers, a barbecue, a full-size bathroom - yeah, we said it, and a patio with gates that open up wide for jumping in to the lake. You will not be disappointed with this experience.

quotes.text: Very Responsible and Fair. After an unfortunate event that prevented my family and I to complete our programmed service with Pier Water Sports, the whole staff were always very kind and helpful and they all showed a good deal of integrity to solve the issue.
